article.title: 杭州OrdoAI測試跨市場創作者工具，邀約與價格由團隊把關
article.summary: OrdoAI公布Ordo Brand邀請制測試，支援按市場挑選創作者、準備多語邀約和跟進合作。
highlights: 工具可從創作者回覆提取報價。
團隊保留寄出邀約、議價、確認成片及付款的責任。
article.why: 出海團隊可減少重複整理工作，並用本地人員核對受眾、用詞和報價口徑。
article.next_step: 用兩個市場的小名單試評，核對創作者資料、翻譯及合作條款，再決定是否寄送。
article.detail: OrdoAI表示，Ordo Brand可按目標市場及活動要求整理創作者名單，協助翻譯邀約、從回覆摘出報價，以及提示待處理的合作事項。工具仍屬邀請制測試。品牌團隊需確認寄出的字句、商業條款、成片及付款，並可先抽查不同市場的報價與內容授權口徑。
article.title_en: Hangzhou's OrdoAI tests cross-market creator tools with human control of outreach and pricing
article.summary_en: OrdoAI announced an invite-only Ordo Brand beta for shortlisting creators, preparing multilingual outreach and tracking collaborations.
highlights_en: The tool can extract quoted rates from creator replies.
Teams retain control of sending, pricing, content approval and payments.
article.why_en: Cross-border teams can streamline record-keeping while local teams check audience fit, wording and rates.
article.next_step_en: Try a small list in two markets and validate creator data, translations and terms before sending.
article.detail_en: OrdoAI says Ordo Brand can shortlist creators by market and brief, translate outreach, extract quoted rates and flag items that need follow-up. Access is invitation-only. Brand teams still handle sending, terms, final content and payment. Compare how each market quotes fees and defines content usage rights.
